turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan from the bank. Is this a convenient time for the brief telephone discussion you requested?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Rachel. Yes, I'm at my desk now. I've been out in the garden this morning, but I've put everything away and have my papers in front of me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for making the time. Has the gardening been keeping you busy?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly pruning and moving pots out of the rain. It's enjoyable, though I tend to lose track of time. For future appointments, an afternoon call would be easier.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that preference for future scheduling. Would you prefer us to arrange an appointment by message before calling, rather than telephone without an agreed time?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: A message beforehand would be helpful. I don't always carry my phone outside, and I'd rather be somewhere quiet with the relevant papers when we speak.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that arrangement. For today's discussion, let us start with your identification details, then move straight to the account matter.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My FIN is F eight nine zero seven three nine one D. My date of birth is the twenty-third of April nineteen sixty-two.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. We can turn to what you wished to discuss.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend selling part of your existing Meridian Asia Equity Fund holding because reducing it would lessen your exposure to regional equity-market fluctuations. A limit order also gives you control over the minimum acceptable sale price.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd appreciate keeping the discussion straightforward. Please take me through the points you need to cover.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Meridian Asia Equity Fund invests in Asian equities, so weaker regional economic conditions or disappointing corporate earnings can reduce its value. Do you understand how those regional economic and corporate earnings risks can affect the value of your holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that weaker regional conditions or disappointing earnings can cause the value of my holding to fall.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.3% of the executed sale value. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling below your original purchase price would realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on the portion you sell?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss when reducing this holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Please give me the transaction details you would like recorded.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am specifying is 25,000,000. The quantity for this transaction is 500 units. Please place a limit order with a minimum sale price of 50,000 Japanese yen per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your final instruction is to sell 500 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund using a limit order at a minimum price of 50,000 Japanese yen per unit, with a stated transaction amount of 25,000,000 in Japanese yen. Do you explicitly confirm this instruction for execution?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction and authorise you to place the order as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes our discussion. I've also noted your preference for arranging future telephone appointments by message. Thank you for your time today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. That was a useful, focused call. I'll get back to the garden now. Goodbye.
